summary: Implemented settings.merge.merge per ADR-004 (recursive dict merge, lists and other values replaced, None in override removes the key, no input mutation via deep copies) and added tests for each rule plus a load() layering test; all 7 tests pass.
assumptions: ADR-004 in docs/DECISIONS.md is the governing spec for details TASK.md leaves unspecified.
None-as-removal applies at every nesting level, and is a no-op when the key is absent from base.
A None value present in base (not override) is kept as a value.
When override supplies a dict where base has a non-dict (or no key), the override dict replaces it, with None values inside it dropped.
'Never mutates' also means the result shares no mutable objects with either input, so results are deep-copied.
